items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I hadn't joined the band at that time. And, Cecil Irving played very good tenor... I joined Earl Hines' band that night, Kenneth and myself.

ctx.x: Boyd Atkins -- of course, you know Omar Simson and Darnell played a lot of clarinet and violin. Of course, they were with Earl. I hadn't -- I used to hear them all the time, but I hadn't joined the band at that time. And, Cecil Irving played very good tenor. And --
I want -- I wanted to ask you about the Doll, the trumpet player --
